title: WorkflowRecipe
description: Declarative SDLC workflow recipe — a named ordered list of phases with optional match rules and budget caps.

name.description: Unique identifier (kebab-case). Used as the --workflow=NAME argument value.

match.description: Deterministic signals for match-based auto-selection of this recipe. ACTIVE: the orchestrator evaluates this block (RESOLVER.md Step 1.5) between the sdlc.local.yaml active_workflow tier and the profile default. A recipe matches iff ALL present conditions are satisfied against the diff signals + $ARGUMENTS; an empty/absent block means the recipe is never auto-selected (explicit choice only). Ties break by highest `priority` (default 0), then most satisfied conditions, then lowest caps.max_total_cost_usd (no cap = +∞), then alphabetical name as a final backstop.

loc_touched_max.description: Recipe matches only when LOC_TOUCHED <= this value.

loc_touched_min.description: Recipe matches only when LOC_TOUCHED >= this value.

has_migrations.description: If true, recipe matches only when HAS_MIGRATIONS == true.

config_only.description: If true, recipe matches only when CONFIG_ONLY == true.

priority.description: Explicit auto-selection tie-break weight; higher wins. Default 0 when absent. Applied FIRST when several recipes match (before specificity/cost/name), so an author can force a recipe to win a tie deterministically — e.g. android-debug sets priority: 10 to beat the generic debug recipe instead of relying on alphabetical order.

phases.description: Ordered list of phases to execute. Each element is a phase-name string, a phase object (name + optional when/loop), or a parallel group. All control flow here is GENERIC — the active stack profile supplies the agent for each named phase.

when.description: Conditional expression evaluated after BA output (Iteration 3+). Example: 'complexity == large'.

loop.description: Generic iterate-back control flow. After this phase runs, if its compact summary reports changes-requested / non-empty findings, the orchestrator re-runs `return_to` then re-runs this phase, up to `max_rounds`. Used e.g. by a review phase bouncing back to development.

return_to.description: Name of an earlier phase to re-execute when this phase requests changes.

max_rounds.description: Cap on iterations before escalating to the user.

oneOf.description: Parallel group — the listed phases are dispatched concurrently (one assistant message, one Agent call per phase). Used e.g. by [security ‖ test].

parallel.description: Phase names to run in parallel.

caps.description: Hard limits for a run of this workflow.

max_total_cost_usd.description: Pipeline halts (with user confirmation) if estimated cost exceeds this value.
